timeline.event: The Lantern Compact is founded: forty outer colonies, each lighting a lantern on its dock.
The Meridian Hegemony begins absorbing Compact worlds by treaty and blockade.
Battle of Ostrava Narrows. Muster Law, Article Nine: Strength Is Presence. The Foundry begins making hollows.
Fall of Karsa Station. The 9th Rearguard breaks out with the Procession.

factions.name: The Lantern Compact
factions.summary: A defeated league whose procedures outlived its institutions.

factions.name: The Meridian Hegemony
factions.summary: Orderly, reasonable, patient. Governs by Reconciliation.

factions.name: The Keepers of Vesper
factions.summary: A silent custodial order guarding the refuge.

factions.name: The Procession
factions.summary: Six thousand two hundred souls in eleven ships.

reserves.note: Ammunition, medicine, fuel and muster drops.

endings.name: The Roll Read
endings.summary: The Procession enters Vesper. The Rearguard reads the whole Roll at the door; the Foundry key is gone; the hollows stop and stand.

endings.name: Orrick's Rest
endings.summary: Orrick is taken alive among six silent bodies. The last person in a room of tallies.

endings.name: Quiet Terms
endings.summary: The squad is counted. The Procession is resettled. Safe, ordinary, and a loss.

endings.name: The Long Watch
endings.summary: The squad holds the door for forty years, hollowing slot by slot as the muster drops keep coming.

glossary.roll: The ledger of the Compact's soldiers, living and not.
glossary.muster: A resupply drop; the moment of refill.
glossary.hollow: A tethered, vat-grown replacement body with the dead soldier's slot number.
glossary.slot: A soldier's number; it outlives them.
glossary.tether: The neural harness and squad net.
glossary.echo: The process of making a hollow.
glossary.strength: The Law's word for a full roll.
glossary.the quiet: The state of Orrick's squad when all six officers are hollow.
